title: McDermott Aviation expands fleet with new Airbus H125
summary: McDermott Aviation said the decision to acquire the H125 was driven by its operational capability, versatility and compatibility with the company's existing fleet.
body_markdown:
Australia’s largest privately owned helicopter operator, McDermott Aviation, has strengthened its fleet with the arrival of a factory-new Airbus[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) helicopter, marking a significant milestone in the company’s ongoing investment in fleet capability, operational efficiency and long-term growth.


Powered by a Safran Arriel 2D engine, the Airbus[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) is widely regarded as one of the world’s most versatile and capable single-engine helicopters, with a proven track record across utility, emergency response and specialist aviation operations globally.


Founder and president of McDermott Aviation, John McDermott, said the acquisition reflects the company’s commitment to continually investing in the aircraft, technology and capability required to support its growing operations.


“Over the past four decades, we have built one of the world’s most capable specialist helicopter fleets through strategic investment, engineering expertise and an unwavering focus on operational excellence,” McDermott said.


“The addition of the Airbus[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) represents another step forward in that journey and provides a modern, highly versatile platform that complements our existing fleet.


“The[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) has an outstanding reputation for reliability, performance and adaptability, making it an excellent fit for our business and the diverse range of operations we undertake.


“As our operations continue to evolve both in Australia and internationally, we will continue investing in the aircraft, people and infrastructure needed to support our clients and maintain our position at the forefront of specialist aviation.”


The decision to acquire the[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) was driven by its operational capability, versatility and compatibility with McDermott Aviation’s existing fleet.


The aircraft shares similarities with the company’s AS355F1 helicopters, providing commonality in maintenance knowledge, tooling and parts support, helping streamline its integration into the fleet while supporting long-term operational efficiencies. The aircraft will be based on the Sunshine Coast.


The acquisition forms part of McDermott Aviation’s broader strategy to continue expanding and modernising its fleet while supporting a diverse range of aviation operations across Australia and overseas.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by McDermott Aviation.*
